node.label: Anomalous tracheal cartilage
node.definition: An abnormality of the C-shaped rings of hyaline cartilage, normally 16 to 20 in number, that occupy the anterior two-thirds of the circumference of the trachea (the posterior portion of the ring is completed by fibrous and smooth muscle tissue).

evidence.snippet: X-linked dominant chondrodysplasia punctata: Anomalous tracheal cartilage (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
